sample_unit: ChatGPT-generated texts on cervical cancer screening

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT cervical cancer screening information with vs without audience persona simplification prompt
links.effect: Mean difficulty 5.32 (STANDARD, at least 15 years of education) vs 4.15 (EASY, 12 years); 21 of 24 indicators significantly improved (p<0.05), but readability remained too high for primary education.
links.quote: While ChatGPT significantly simplified MICC_GPT, the readability levels remained too high for patients with only primary education.

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient information versus intended low-education users
links.effect: Standard output required at least 15 years of formal education; simplified output still required 12 years, above the 8 years of primary education.
links.quote: The average difficulty level of STANDARD output was 5.32 (at least 15 years of formal education), while EASY output averaged 4.15 (12 years of formal education).

unlisted_practices: Audience persona prompting to simplify LLM-generated patient information

screen.reason: The study compares ChatGPT outputs generated with standard zero-shot prompting versus audience persona prompting designed to constrain reading level for patient comprehension.
